title: Humanoid robots now have their own combat competition
caption:
Unitree is inviting the world to watch the CMG 2026 Humanoid Robot Combat Competition — a full tournament where humanoid robots face off in the ring.

The idea is to put the technology to the test through combat, pushing balance, reaction speed and durability far beyond what a lab demo ever could. Unitree calls it a new chapter in the co-evolution of humans and AI.
